narrative.headline: Top 50 tilts decisively bullish — 24 of 50 names BULLISH or LEAN BULLISH led by mega-cap tech, semis, and select financials, with concentrated bearish pressure in payments, defensives, and AMD/META.
bullish_setups: LLY: perfect 10/10/10 composite — flow $9.1M paired with $314M dark pool, institutions accumulating across all three channels
GOOG/GOOGL: combined ~$57M call premium + $1.27B dark pool across the share classes — heaviest mega-cap accumulation on the board
NVDA: $35M call premium + $1.12B dark pool (largest single-name darkpool print) — conviction buying despite only 8.62 flow score
AMAT: 9.59 composite with $432M dark pool — semicap equipment getting smart money bid alongside KLAC (8.20)
INTC: strongest flow score in semis at 9.57 with $19M call premium — directional positioning, not just structural
C: near-perfect 9.95 composite, $254M dark pool — standout in financials against weak JPM
TSLA: $26M call premium + $906M dark pool — institutional re-engagement
NFLX/COST/PLTR/ORCL: all 8.7+ composites with dark pool prints $270M–$450M confirming flow direction
bearish_setups: META: flow collapses to 3.36 despite $10/10 darkpool+blocks — large prints amplifying bearish options positioning
AMD: 3.68 flow vs bullish NVDA/INTC/AMAT — clear intra-semi rotation against AMD
V: 3.60 flow with heavy block/darkpool conviction — payments distribution
CAT: 3.18 flow + max darkpool/blocks — industrials cyclicals seeing institutional unwind
JPM & XOM: zero flow scores with maxed darkpool/blocks — large-print distribution in money-center bank and energy supermajor
PG, PEP: zero flow + 8.9+ darkpool — staples being quietly sold
GEV: 0.99 flow — power/utilities momentum name losing institutional sponsorship
MU: 4.90 flow — only semi name on bearish side, diverges from broader chip strength
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation into AI/semicap complex (NVDA, GOOG/GOOGL, AMAT, KLAC, INTC, ORCL, PLTR) and select consumer (NFLX, COST, PM, LLY), funded by distribution out of defensives (PG, PEP), payments (V), money-center banks (JPM), energy (XOM), and industrials (CAT). Semis show internal rotation: longs in INTC/AMAT/KLAC/NVDA against shorts in AMD and MU.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: JPM bearish at the mega-cap level while C is near-perfect bullish — suggests financials read is name-specific, not sector-wide. META bearish despite broader mega-cap tech strength is the cleanest divergence to flag. AMD bearish inside an otherwise bullish semiconductor tape is the second.
